summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, announcing its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results. The filing reports profit of $368.8 million, EBITDA of $558.3 million, and a contract backlog of $3.26 billion. It also states an intention to distribute $0.64 per share. The press release discusses vessel deliveries, sales of older ships, and strong market conditions. No transaction, special-purpose event, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to an earnings press release in the U.S.
